content: Design system consistency pitfalls for a marketing site rebuild: (1) token drift — palette defined as CSS vars but re-hardcoded inline per section; the warning sign is any hardcoded hex in component files; (2) competing design directions — mixing editorial (Fraunces) and brutalist (Bricolage) typography signals no resolved identity; fix is to choose one type system before writing any component; (3) AI-generated look symptoms: generic card layouts, too many font weights, copy-paste section templates with no visual threading, mismatched spacing scales; (4) no design audit gate means sections accumulate individual decisions that break coherence; establish per-section visual review before moving on.
